summary: Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass end-to-end (setup + auth, dashboard, upload/columns/validate summary correctness, batch queue with atomic /next claim, JobResult idempotency with duplicate_ignored, pause/resume requeue of in-flight SENDING, control-state gating of /next, xlsx export streaming, export token check, test SMS via same queue, history filter+search, settings PUT persistence, token regenerate rotates and invalidates old). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, DEMO_MODE web preview): all 5 primary screens render with correct testIDs (Dashboard, Upload, History, Settings, Test SMS modal). Dashboard shows live gateway/SIM/network status, Today's Sent hero card, Pending & Failed stat cards, Last activity — all reflecting real backend data. Settings screen shows gateway ID, token masked with reveal/copy/regenerate/revoke, delay stepper (3s), country code +91. History shows filters (All/Sent/Failed/Pending), real items with simulated (demo) marker, timestamps, message IDs. Upload screen renders dropzone. Test SMS modal accepts mobile + message inputs and has Send button. Bottom tab navigation works between all tabs. Real integration confirmed (settings/dashboard/history all display DB-backed data through the token pipeline).

minor.issue: Uses today = date.today().isoformat() as a string prefix ($gte) against created_at ISO strings — works correctly today but tz-agnostic; if server tz drifts vs UTC, day boundary could count wrong window. Consider computing from a UTC datetime.

Currently returns the token to ANY caller with no auth (by design for single-user private device). If the preview URL is public, anyone can fetch the token. Acceptable per product spec but worth noting.

integration_issues.issue: expo-document-picker on web dynamically creates and removes a hidden <input type=file>, which makes end-to-end Playwright automation of the file-pick step unreliable (page.wait_for_event('filechooser') times out and dynamic input is destroyed before set_input_files takes effect). Backend API verified to accept multipart uploads (test_upload passes with 6-row xlsx). Real users clicking the button in a browser work as expected — only automation is affected.

issues: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' (RN Web 0.19+). Non-blocking but should be migrated for cleanliness.
Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from a phosphor-icon or component. Non-blocking.

action_items: Consider migrating 'shadow*' style props to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Optional: compute today's dashboard window from a UTC datetime rather than date.isoformat() string prefix, so day-boundary aggregation is timezone-safe.
Optional: rate-limit or restrict POST /api/gateway/setup once a token exists (currently freely returns the existing token — by design for single-user, but exposed if the preview URL leaks).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly separates concerns (auth, validation, batch queue, export). Under 720 lines — no split needed yet.
JobResult transition uses find_one_and_update with status:'SENDING' guard → correctly idempotent; duplicate reports return duplicate_ignored: true.
Pause/Stop correctly requeues in-flight SENDING back to PENDING (test_pause_requeues_sending covers this).
MongoDB ObjectId is always popped ('_id') before returning — no serialization issues.
Backend uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] and DB_NAME with no defaults — fails fast on misconfig ✓.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for BASE ✓. Token stored in SecureStore, sent as X-Gateway-Token header on every mutating call ✓.
All interactive elements audited have testID props ✓.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — all screens render and integrations verified via real data; only the Upload→Preview→Batch path could not be fully automated on web due to expo-document-picker web limitations, backend flow already validated end-to-end via pytest.

seed_data_creation: Pytest suite creates TEST_-prefixed rows (xlsx uploaded, jobs marked sent/failed with simulated:true). Left in DB by design so history endpoint can be exercised; safe since prefixed with TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Gateway token is fetched via POST /api/gateway/setup (idempotent). Frontend is Expo Web in DEMO_MODE — sends are simulated (simulated:true). To automate the Upload flow, prefer directly hitting POST /api/files with multipart to bypass expo-document-picker web quirks. Preview token in the review request may be stale — always fetch current token via /api/gateway/setup at test start.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Only observed non-blocking RN Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) and a Playwright-only limitation with expo-document-picker on web (real users unaffected).
